candidates.name: Search for triangulation stations
verified_facts: OS states that archived triangulation-station coordinates have not been realised via ETRS89 and OSTN15 and are no longer considered true current OSGB36 National Grid coordinates of the stations.
The expected agreement with ETRS89/OSTN15-derived coordinates is around 0.10m RMS for triangulation stations down to third order.
semantic_limits: A triangulation archive coordinate is not current GNSS control and cannot be used as direct parcel terrain-height evidence.

candidates.name: Search for benchmarks
verified_facts: OS benchmark heights in the lower-order archive have not been regularly maintained for decades and subsidence has affected values in some areas.
OS states that GPS with OSGM15 is the preferred modern method of heighting, while Fundamental Bench Marks remain part of the primary ODN height network.
semantic_limits: An unverified local benchmark archive height must not be treated as a current parcel elevation without stability checks, datum validation and contemporary survey evidence.
